intro.title: Next.js App Router Fundamentals
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple multi-page web application using Next.js App Router to understand how routing works in modern React frameworks. You'll learn the core concept of file-based routing, where the structure of your project's files automatically determines the URLs of your application. The main technologies involved are Next.js, React components, and special files like page.js and layout.js. By the end, you'll have a working app with multiple pages and a shared layout, all set up through the App Router's intuitive conventions.
intro.usecase: The Next.js App Router is the foundation for building modern web applications with structured navigation and optimized performance. You'll use it to create e-commerce sites where product pages, shopping carts, and checkout flows are organized in clear routes, or dashboards where different sections like analytics, user management, and settings are separated into logical paths. This pattern appears in applications like project management tools where tasks, teams, and reports each have dedicated routes, or content platforms where articles, user profiles, and search results are efficiently organized. Mastering the App Router helps you build maintainable applications with proper separation of concerns and optimized loading strategies.
